exposure: infant's distress factors after caesarean section
type of anaesthesia used in caesarean section
cohort: 200 mothers and 200 accompanying fathers/partners 12-24 hours after birth at a level III maternity centre in Sherbrooke, Quebec, Canada
finding: While both mothers and fathers reported high global satisfaction with the birth experience, mothers reported more distress during labor, while fathers reported less perceived support and care satisfaction.
mod_finding: For mothers, epidural use during vaginal birth and type of anesthesia used in cesarean section predicted lower satisfaction; for fathers, instrumental delivery, primary cesarean delivery, and infant distress after cesarean section predicted lower satisfaction.
cross-section timing: 12-24 h after birth over a 6-week period
